later_review_audit.description: Element Desktop enables Electron autoUpdater on macOS and Windows when update_base_url is configured, using a macOS JSON feed or a Windows Squirrel feed. Its source includes Windows signing build configuration; payload authenticity enforcement remains delegated to Electron/Squirrel and is unresolved here.

original_evidence.text: | Element Desktop | element-hq/element-desktop | Electron (built-in Electron `autoUpdater`, i.e. Squirrel.Mac / Squirrel.Windows — not the `electron-updater` npm package) | Y | auto (background poll every hour after a 30s initial delay; downloads automatically; install happens via `quitAndInstall()` triggered from a UI "restart to update" action, not silently on its own) | Y | https (macOS: `${update_base_url}macos/releases.json`, JSON feed; Windows: `${update_base_url}win32/<arch>/`, Squirrel-style) | N (feed JSON itself carries no separate signature; integrity relies on the OS-level updater mechanism below) | OS-code-signing (Squirrel.Mac requires the downloaded update bundle be signed with the same Developer ID/Team as the running app or the update silently fails to apply; Squirrel.Windows relies on NuGet-style package + Update.exe, no explicit `verifyUpdateCodeSignature` call found — no `electron-updater` in this codebase, it uses Electron's built-in `autoUpdater` module) | OS-trust-store (macOS Gatekeeper/code-signing identity match enforced by Squirrel.Mac/Electron, not an app-pinned key) | `src/updater.ts:74-116` (`start()` sets `autoUpdater.setFeedURL`, platform-specific JSON/base-path feeds, hourly `setInterval(pollForUpdates, UPDATE_POLL_INTERVAL_MS)`); `src/updater.ts:19-24` (`installUpdate()` calls `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`, wired to IPC `install_update`, i.e. user-triggered); `src/electron-main.ts:427-430` (`update_base_url` sourced from runtime `vectorConfig`, not hardcoded in this repo — publicly known official value is `https://packages.element.io/desktop/update/`); Windows Squirrel glue at `src/squirrelhooks.ts` (no signature check code present) |

| Element Desktop | `Element Desktop` | Tier B. Electron native `autoUpdater`, HTTPS; mac relies on Squirrel.Mac code-sign, win on Squirrel.Windows with no explicit payload sig check visible in-repo. |
